instruction: I am going on a trip to Bangkok with some of my friends. We are managing its planning on a Todoist project for it. One of the tasks in it is about preparing a Spotify playlist. I have made the playlist and shared it with others on the project. But they have made some suggestions in comments. Please incorporate them, leave a final comment, "Thanks! Updated.", and mark it complete.

todoist_token = apis.todoist.login(username='jamie-solomon@gmail.com', password={c['account_name']:c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() }['todoist'])['access_token']

def fetch_tasks(project_id):
    res = apis.todoist.show_tasks(project_id=project_id, access_token=todoist_token)
    return res

for pid in [280,281]:
    res = fetch_tasks(pid)
    # gather task summaries
    task_summaries=[]
    if res is None:
        print('project',pid,'no res')
        continue
    for t in res.get('no_section_tasks',[]):
        task_summaries.append({'task_id':t['task_id'],'title':t['title'],'desc':t.get('description','')[:80],'completed':t['is_completed']})
    for sec in res.get('sections',[]):
        for t in sec.get('tasks',[]):
            task_summaries.append({'task_id':t['task_id'],'title':t['title'],'desc':t.get('description','')[:80],'completed':t['is_completed'],'section':sec.get('section_id')})
    print('PROJECT',pid,'num_tasks',len(task_summaries))
    # print those with spotify/playlist keywords
    hits=[t for t in task_summaries if any(k in (t['title']+' '+t['desc']).lower() for k in ['spotify','playlist','music'])]
    print('  spotify_hits',len(hits))
    print('  first_hits',hits[:10])

def fetch_task_comments(task_id):
    page_index=0

        if not page:

        out.extend(page)
        if len(page)<page_limit:

# spotify search function

def search_song_id(title, artists, query=None):
    # use query if given, else title + first artist
    q = query or (title + ' ' + (artists[0] if artists else ''))
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    results = []
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, access_token=spotify_token)
        print('search page', page_index, 'for', q, 'len', 0 if not page else len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    # choose best match
    title_l = title.strip().lower()
    artist_set = {a.strip().lower() for a in (artists or []) if a.strip()}
    # exact title matches
    candidates=[]
    for r in results:
        r_title = (r.get('title') or '').strip().lower()
        if r_title != title_l:
            continue
        r_artists = [a.get('name','').strip().lower() for a in (r.get('artists') or [])]
        # if artists provided, require overlap
        if artist_set:
            if any(a in r_artists for a in artist_set):
                candidates.append(r)
        else:
            candidates.append(r)
    # tiebreaker: first candidate
    if candidates:
        return candidates[0]['song_id'], q, candidates[0]
    # fallback: title substring match
    for r in results:
        if title_l in (r.get('title','').strip().lower()):
            return r['song_id'], q, r
    return None, q, (results[0] if results else None)
